author: reek
body: Texture mipmapping shown on a perspective floor. Near the camera the checker texture is sampled at full detail; with distance the pixel selects a coarser mip level (a larger, smoother average) so the far floor stops shimmering. The chosen mip level tints the floor faintly so the LOD bands are visible. Reference site's "texture mipmap generation" technique. Float math from DeviceMath.

author: reek
body: Checker value at a given mip cell size (larger cell = coarser mip). At coarse mips the checker averages toward 0.5.
